manifest.timing_scope: one warm process, perf_counter wall clock; parsing/decompression/filtering included; no fresh-process isolation or significance claims

fixture.method: sha256(schema JSON + pandas hash_pandas_object ordered rows/index bytes); pandas version recorded in manifest

pushdown_eval.method: evaluate_pushdown(predicate, store.labels); includes label materialization, traversal and full candidate/skipped ID outputs; no AS OF index

full_scan.mean_estimand: raw untrimmed arithmetic mean of all measured trials
full_scan.trimmed_estimand: descriptive fastest retained fraction; no inferential interval
full_scan.uncertainty_method: descriptive Student-t interval, raw mean +/- t(0.975, n-1) * sample SE (t=2.110 for n=18); coverage not established; no significance test
